messages:
Ana Chen: Quick sync — need a go/no-go on the combined connector bundle (Snowflake + Databricks + vector DB adapters) for a marketplace announcement next Wed.
Jordan Park: Got a failing case in schema-align test, see snippet below.
Jordan Park: ```bash
pytest tests/integrations/test_schema_align.py::TestSnowflakeMapping -k mismatch
# failing on nested struct -> flattened mapping
```
Li Wang: I'll run a sample ingest across 10k rows to reproduce. ETA 30m.
Sam Ortiz: What are the announcement constraints? Do we have partner marketing assets & announcement embargo?
Maya Patel: Partners need a 72h review window. Also need the marketplace listing screenshots and cert badge. I have the design brief ready.
Ana Chen: Ok — proposed plan: Li to validate ingest (today), Jordan to fix mapping or provide a rollback mapping (tomorrow AM), Maya to collect assets (tomorrow EOD), Sam to coordinate press & embargo. If all green, announce Wed 9am PT. 
Jordan Park: Quick workaround: add `--preserve-nested` flag to the adapter to keep types stable. Patch attached.
Jordan Park: ```diff
- flatten_structs = true
+ flatten_structs = os.getenv('PRESERVE_NESTED', 'false') == 'true'
```
Li Wang: Verified ingest with `--preserve-nested` — no type errors. I pushed sample results to the partner-test bucket: gs://rwd-partner-tests/connector-samples/173716.
Sam Ortiz: I'll draft the partner PR and lock the embargo -> sending draft to Maya & Ana for review.
deploy-bot: calendar invite created: 'Connector bundle partner announce' Wed 09:00 PT — attendees: Ana Chen, Sam Ortiz, Maya Patel, Jordan Park.
Ana Chen: Thanks. If Jordan's patch is needed, we'll ship hotfix to dedicated and set canary 10% before rollout.
Maya Patel: Heads up — Databricks legal requested a short compliance blurb. Sam, can you add a 1-liner about data residency?
Sam Ortiz: On it. I'll add: "Data processed through Redwood's connectors remains in customer-controlled storage and complies with partner residency requirements." Please review.
Li Wang: All test logs look good. I'll schedule a soak (4h) on staging after Jordan's patch merges.
Ana Chen: Solid. Next check-in tomorrow 10am PT. Thanks team :rocket:
